headline: 🔥 A brand-new agent walks 195 Lake View at 9:00 THIS MORNING — competing interest arriving while yesterday's re-offer still waits on your seller. Tomorrow 9:00 is the Lake Crest inspection and you have a written backup buyer nobody has called. Meanwhile 9 showings still owe reads and you owe feedback on 7 homes you toured.

hotSignals.signal: 🔥 COMPETING SHOWING TODAY 9:00 AM — William K. (Killough Bailey Properties) booked and confirmed at 7:20 PM last night. He has never shown this house; this is showing #10 all-time. It lands while the conditional re-offer from 12:16 PM yesterday is still sitting unanswered on your seller's desk.
hotSignals.action: Call Chesley C. BEFORE 9:00. Lead with the 7/19 read you promised him three days ago, then the number, then this: somebody new is walking the house this morning. A second interested party is the only thing that fixes the weak spot in the re-offer — their own home is still NOT under contract and goes live Monday. Do not answer the buyer side before your seller rules. Then chase William K. for feedback the same afternoon.

hotSignals.action: ⏰ THE INSPECTION IS TOMORROW 9:00 AM — that is the one window where this deal can die, and the backup call has now gone two days unmade. Call Kulsum today and ask for a written backup at or near list. It costs you nothing and quietly strengthens you on any repair ask.
